plan.reason: The forecast predicts a cold day with temperatures dropping to -5.1°C at 3 PM, which is well below the current outdoor temperature of -3.5°C. Given that the cores are already at 21.4°C and there's no significant solar gain or occupancy load pushing them into cooling, it would be prudent to set a higher ceiling to avoid unnecessary reheat during the day when temperatures are expected to drop further. Setting the supply air temperature ceiling at 15.0°C allows for some margin in case of slight temperature drops while ensuring that zones do not overcool and require excessive reheating.
